o1.biggest_mistake: Test 5 changes the hero image and the reviews position in one go, so if it wins the team cannot tell which change earned the lift.

reason: Output 1 reads like it was written for my store: it sizes the broken in-app checkout at the ₹34 lakh I calculated, ships the trial line, the star rating and the tracking this week, and lays out a run schedule I can hand over.
